predecessors.name: Han dynasty
predecessors.text: Yi Province, 'covering present-day Sichuan and Chongqing' (Liu Zhang page)

successors.name: Shu Han
successors.text: Yi Province, 'covering present-day Sichuan and Chongqing' (Liu Zhang page)

rulers.name: Liu Zhang
rulers.title: Inspector, then Governor of Yi Province

ledger.x: 214: Chengdu is surrounded and Liu Zhang surrenders: 'by 214 they had surrounded Yi Province's capital, Chengdu'; 'He then surrendered to Liu Bei' ('I don't want my subjects to suffer any more').
214: Yi Province passes to Liu Bei, who 'relocated him to Gong'an County in Jing Province' (Liu Bei page); the summary table: 'Defeated Liu Zhang and took over Yi Province' in 214.

wars.name: Liu Bei's conquest of Yi Province
wars.outcome: Liu Bei, invited in 211 against Zhang Lu, fought Liu Zhang from 213, took Luo in 214 and received the surrender of Chengdu.

certainty.note: The pages give no frontier for Yi Province; the shape is the two modern units the Liu Zhang page names.
